The 3 new tracks that were part of the Firewall update would loop infinitely for some users, therefore the tracks wouldn't switch automatically unless you used the jukebox manually.

notes.title: Update v1.2.4, Win7 crashes @ NVIDIA drivers
notes.content:
Hello fellow Hackers!

Just released a small update with few fixes!

[h1]Unlocked levels[/h1]
Certain players experienced issue with all levels being unlocked right away, this issue has been fixed.

[h1]Audio sliders[/h1]
There was an issue with audio sliders, you didn't have as much control with them as you'd like.
After lowering the slider by around a third, the audio would be muted.
I fixed this and how the audio slider has much bigger range and it's easier to tweak the volume to your liking.

[h1]Windows 7 - Crashes[/h1]
I've learned today that some users are experiencing game crashing issues.
Currently the problem seems to be isolated mostly to Windows 7 and not having updated NVIDIA drivers. Updating the drivers should solve this issue. I am currently looking into ways to solve this.

notes.title: UPDATE v1.2.3
notes.content:
Hello fellow Hackers!

Just released a small update for Hack Grid.

[h1]Colorblind mode[/h1]
I've received a feedback about how to improve my colorblind support.
Before the update, icons would appear in the corner of each piece which would show what color it is.
However, it wasn't as practical as I had hoped. 

Therefore, the colorblind mode turns the colors of pieces into strong, shining red, green and blue
This works very well with most types of colorblindness.

If you are colorblind, depending on which colors you cannot see, try playing with the colorblind mode on and off. For some types, the game looks just fine even with the default colors!

[h1]Dutch localization[/h1]
I've learned that there were some issues with the Dutch translation.
I'm sorry this wasn't caught earlier. It is fixed now though!

If you run into any issues, I've created a pinned Topic [b]Report an Issue[/b] in the game's discussion, you can report the issue there.

Thanks and good luck hacking the grid!

- Martin

tags.feature: Therefore, the colorblind mode turns the colors of pieces into strong, shining red, green and blue
